Kit summary

Bloodrend MomentumActive
Deals 2 stages of Bleed DMG (5% of Genjiro's Max HP each) to one enemy. The second stage steals 10% of the target's Tenacity and Mastery RES (each enemy can be stolen from up to 2 times).
Bloodbath of a ThousandActive
Deals 2 stages of Bleed DMG (5% of Genjiro's Max HP each) to all enemies. The second stage reduces non-Boss targets' Tenacity and Mastery RES by 20% (up to 100% each) and Genjiro gains 20% of the amount reduced. Copies the Tenacity and Mastery RES stolen by Bloodrend Momentum and Bloodbath of a Thousand to other allies, overwriting existing values.
Samurai Spirit Lv.1Casting it inflicts Chill II (-40% Skill DMG dealt, 1 turn) on all enemies and removes 1 layer of DMG Immunity. Afterwards allies deal +20% of Tenacity as DMG (up to 30%; up to 60% for allies with Genji Blood Mark; does not stack with other Tenacity-to-DMG effects). Genjiro also casts it once after another Blood Mark ally casts a skill (once before he acts), and up to 2 times when another ally casts a skill while stealing Mastery and Mastery RES.
Genji Iron OathPassive
Starts battle with Genji Blood Mark (reduces HP lost to DMG by 40% and records it; next turn the recorded value is settled into Genji Iron Aegis equal to 60% of it for 2 turns). If Genjiro has the highest initial Tenacity among allies, the ally with the highest initial ATK also gets the mark. When a Blood Mark unit ends its turn, Genjiro gains 20% Turn Meter.
Samurai Spirit Lv.2Blood Mark units are immune to control. After a Blood Mark unit casts a skill, Genjiro gains 100% Turn Meter (once per battle). After Genjiro's skill hits a non-Boss, other Blood Mark allies gain 10% Turn Meter and 10% Skill DMG (stacks up to 5; up to 2 times before he acts). After 10 steals by an enemy before it acts, or when an enemy steals Genjiro's SPD, Genji Seal Curse (cannot steal attributes) is inflicted; the latter also inflicts it on all enemies and grants allies 1 layer of Oath of Immortality. Settling the mark now settles 100% of recorded DMG and grants Iron Aegis equal to 80% of it for 2 turns. A Blood Mark unit taking Fatal DMG clears its record, restores HP equal to 100% of Genjiro's Max HP and gains Iron Aegis equal to 100% of the cleared value for 2 turns (once per unit per battle).
Samurai Spirit Lv.3Increases ATK of allies with the Bleed or Attribute Steal tag by 2% of Genjiro's initial Max HP (does not stack with other Bleed ATK increases). If 5 Attribute Steal allies are deployed at battle start, all allies get 2 layers of Oath of Immortality and Iron Aegis equal to 40% of Genjiro's Max HP for 2 turns.
Crimson CrusadeUltimate
Cleanses all debuffs from allies and grants 1 layer of Oath of Immortality for 2 turns (max 3; triggers below 66%/50%/33% HP, owner loses only 1 HP from DMG). Grants all allies Genji Iron Aegis equal to 40% of Genjiro's Max HP (a Shield that cannot be removed or stolen). Then deals 2 stages of Bleed DMG to all enemies: 10% of Genjiro's Max HP, then 20% of his lost HP (min 5% of Max HP).
Samurai Spirit Lv.3When another Blood Mark ally proactively casts a skill on its own turn, Crimson Crusade CD -1 turn. Each cast on non-Boss targets grants all allies Mastery Up II (+50%) and SPD Up II (+40%) for 2 turns. Each cast on a Boss reduces its Mastery RES by 80%, increases Basic Attack DMG taken by 300% for 4 turns and removes 1 layer of its Shield.
Samurai Spirit (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
